description: Weekly updates, all patch/minor in one PR (mise lint/format tools in their own), auto-merged on green CI after a 7-day cooldown. Majors come in their own PRs and auto-merge on green CI as well. A merge that changes the app triggers a patch release (auto-release.yml).

packageRules.description: All patch/minor/pin/digest updates in one PR
mise tools (lint/format) in their own PR, so a new lint rule can't block the actions
Majors in their own PRs, auto-merged on green CI like the rest
